    """True when the byte has an odd number of set bits."""
    ex parity(0) == False
    ex parity(1) == True
    ex parity(3) == False
    ex parity(7) == True
    ex parity(255) == False
    count: uint8 = 0
    for i in range(8):
        count = count + ((x >> i) & 1)
    return count % 2 == 1
